test_title: PYST 23: Selection Post (Graduate Level) - GA (Held On 25 Jul, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which government scheme aims to provide affordable housing to the urban poor and economically weaker sections?

options.text: Atal Mission for Rejuvenation and Urban Transformation (AMRUT)
Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana-National Urban Livelihoods Mission (DAY-NULM)

solution:
The correct answer is __**Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban (PMAY-U)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban (PMAY-U)** was launched on **25 June 2015** with the vision of providing **"Housing for All"** in urban areas.
 
• It is a flagship program implemented by the **Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (MoHUA)** of the **Government of India**.
 
• The mission aims to provide **pucca houses** to all eligible urban households, including **slum dwellers**, by the end of the mission period. ***Hence, the statement regarding affordable housing for the urban poor is correct.***
 
• The scheme addresses the housing requirements of the urban poor including the **Economically Weaker Section (EWS)**, **Low Income Group (LIG)**, and **Middle Income Group (MIG)** categories.
 
• The **target beneficiaries** include individuals who do not own a pucca house in their name or in the name of any member of their family in any part of **India**.
